subject: Grafana migration + retention add-ons coordination
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Navarro <alex.navarro@grafanacloud.com>, Priya Sharma <priya@datadog.com>, Ellen Park <ellen.park@sentry.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-03T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Observability stack coordination — migration + retention add-ons

Hi all,

We’re kicking off a short program to reduce dashboard duplication and optimize storage spend across Grafana Cloud, Datadog, and Sentry for the next 12 months. High level asks:

- Grafana: migration plan and firm cost for managed dashboards + alerting (target pilot: 25 teams, 3 months).
- Datadog: formal quote for 365-day logs retention add-on and ingestion tier for our projected Q4 volume.
- Sentry: confirmation on improved ingest pricing for grouped errors if we move more error monitoring there.

I’ve attached a rough migration_scope.xlsx that lists teams, dashboards, and rough traffic/queries — please review and return a short SOW / quote by 2026-10-08 so procurement can bundle.

Key constraints: budget approval cycle closes 10/20, and we’d like a POC that doesn’t require multi-month integrations before EOY. If any contract amendments are required (esp. cross-vendor termination windows or data egress clauses), please flag early.

Next step: can each vendor confirm availability for a 30-minute sync this week? Proposed times in the attachment.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Product Manager, Observability
Redwood Inference
(attachment: migration_scope.xlsx)

From: Alex Navarro <alex.navarro@grafanacloud.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-04T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Observability stack coordination — migration + retention add-ons

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks for the brief. Grafana Cloud can definitely run a 25-team pilot; attached is a preliminary SOW and high-level timeline (grafana-migration-sow.pdf). Highlights:

- 6-week pilot per team cohort with automated dashboard import tooling and template mapping.
- Managed hosting + alerting: flat onboarding fee + per-seat dashboard rate (saw savings in previous customers by reducing redundant dashboards).
- Optional: migration assistance for panels that rely on Datadog-specific integrations (we’ll provide a delta list after a quick inventory).

We can join a sync on 10/06 10:00–10:30 PT. For contract redlines, happy to work with Ben/Legal on standard terms; we do require 60 days notice on subscription changes.

Attaching the SOW for your procurement review.

Best,
Alex Navarro
Strategic Accounts — Grafana Cloud
(attachment: grafana-migration-sow.pdf)

Thanks for the heads up. I’ve attached a retention quote (dd-retention-quote.xlsx) that shows pricing for 90/180/365-day tiers and a blended ingress estimate for Q4. Two notes:

1) If you retain Datadog for logs only but move dashboards to Grafana, you’ll still need the log shipping agent in your stacks; we can scope a lighter agent-only plan to cut costs.
2) Egress: our billing model includes standard egress for archived logs; any export automation to third-party visualization platforms may incur extra egress depending on volume — worth discussing.

Happy to join the sync and align on minimal coupling with Grafana during the pilot.

Date: 2026-10-12T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Observability stack coordination — migration + retention add-ons

Team,

Thanks for the quick turn. Legal review notes and procurement asks below — please treat as inbound requirements for any contract changes or addenda.

1) Data portability: any SOW or amendment must include explicit export SLAs for raw logs and dashboard exports. We need a documented handoff procedure (format, estimated time-to-export) in case we revert or run a dual-mode.
2) Egress & Pricing Caps: Datadog — please confirm a quarterly cap option for egress to limit surprise bills during the pilot. Grafana — confirm whether your onboarding fee can be credited against a 12-month commitment.
3) Termination windows: we prefer symmetric 30-day termination for pilots; if vendors require 60 days, note that in the SOW and we’ll escalate.
4) Security evidence: for any private deployment work, provide SOC2 report and a list of sub-processors. Sanjay (vendor counsel) — please prepare redline template; I’ve attached contract-redlines.docx with standard Redwood clauses.

Procurement decision path: if SOW + commercial terms can be aligned by 10/18, we’ll approve a scoped POC and commit to a 12-month review. Otherwise, we’ll ask for a phased approach starting with 3 teams.

Please reply with the items above (export SLA template, egress cap options, SOC2 PDF link, and any changes to your stated notice periods).

Ben Carter
Head of Procurement
Redwood Inference
(attachment: contract-redlines.docx)
